defs.def: a mountain with a large opening at the top through which gases and lava (= hot liquid rock) are forced out into the air, or have been in the past 火山

ex.s: Put on your hiking boots and explore islands with waterfalls and active volcanoes.
ex.t: 穿上你的登山靴，去探索有瀑布和活火山的岛屿吧。

ex.s: What caused the disappearance of dinosaurs: 1 a huge meteorite hitting Earth 2 ash and gas from erupting volcanoes 3 disease Among the many unsolved mysteries about dinosaurs, what really interests me is their disappearance.
ex.t: 是什么导致了恐龙的消失：1 一颗巨大陨石撞击地球 2 火山喷发产生的灰烬和气体 3 疾病 在关于恐龙的诸多未解之谜中，真正让我感兴趣的是它们的消失。

ex.s: The couple who live next to us volunteered to help after the volcano erupted.
ex.t: 住在隔壁的夫妇在火山爆发后主动前来帮忙。

ex.s: NATURAL DISASTERS electricity volcano flood landslide drought shelter 4 Translate the sentences into English using the words and phrases in brackets.
ex.t: 自然灾害 电 火山 洪水 山体滑坡 干旱 避难所 4 用括号中的单词和短语将下列句子翻译成英语。

ex.s: It was a 1,200-square-foot room that was on the side of a volcano and used the sun for energy.
ex.t: 那是一个1200平方英尺的房间，位于火山侧翼，以太阳能为能源。
